decisions.decision: Karin suggested the DPW director have his administrative assistant track down the name of the uninsured driver who damaged the Town Beach fence and send a bill.
decisions.quote: to track down the name of the driver and send a bill.

decisions.decision: Picnic tables and a possible shade structure at the beach playground area were agreed to be added to the master plan as it is created.
decisions.quote: dennis though those were good ideas and we can add it to our master plan as we create it.

decisions.decision: Dennis said the Chestnut Street parking concern is big enough to continue discussions with the Fire Chief and Police Chief.
decisions.quote: dennis thinks the concern is big enough to continue having discussions with the fire chief and police chief.

decisions.decision: Karin will follow up with the Little League about whether tee ball player fees were waived for 2018.
decisions.quote: dennis suggested karin follow up with them to see and see what they say.

decisions.decision: Karin will try to find Dan Proctor's email to reach out to him about using the 90' diamond at Marshall Park.
decisions.quote: she would try and find his email to reach out to him.

decisions.decision: Karin will go back to Garry Rhodes on the Whalom Road playground and ask how he would like to proceed.
decisions.quote: karin said she would go back to garry rhodes and see how he would like to proceed

decisions.decision: The commission agreed it needs to make its needs known to the Town Manager, in hopes of bringing in someone to oversee day-to-day park needs.
decisions.quote: the commission needs to make their needs known to the town

decisions.decision: Dennis said the board should set aside the past and build a big-picture plan, and should receive regular budget updates.
decisions.quote: we need to come up with the big picture and also be getting regular budget updates.

decisions.decision: Dennis suggested a feasibility study or survey to gather more information on field space needs.
decisions.quote: dennis though a feasibility study or survey to get more information would be beneficial.

decisions.decision: Jack noted a past resident interest in a land swap and suggested the commission could look further into it.
decisions.quote: a resident in town was interested in a land swap and we could look further into that.

decisions.decision: Karin will follow up on the online payment setup for beach pass registrations, with Adam Burney to do his part and reach back out.
decisions.quote: adam was going to do some leg work on his side and then reach back out to her.
